'''Jhen Honey''' was a kind of thick, sweet, viscous [[Honey/Legends|honey]] sometimes used in [[Caf/Legends|caf]]. It was popular with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
